articles.title: Sanctions on settlers not enough: Target Israeli gov’t, say campaigners
articles.summary: Western nations have imposed new sanctions on Israeli settlers and far-right ministers due to their actions. Human rights groups and Palestinian campaigners, however, criticize these measures as insufficient. They argue the sanctions fail to address systemic state complicity in actions against Palestinians, highlighting a call for more comprehensive international intervention to tackle the root causes of the conflict.

articles.title: Sam Reid Knows Rock-Star Lestat Needs Louis’s Validation
articles.summary: The article previews the season premiere of 'The Vampire Lestat' (formerly 'Interview With the Vampire'), which aired on June 7 on AMC. It focuses on spoilers, particularly concerning Sam Reid's portrayal of Lestat de Lioncourt and potential plot developments related to 'Detroit'. articles.title: ‘These injection injuries are real’: U.S. senator demands COVID-shot injuries be given disease classification
articles.summary: Hospital Corpsman 3rd Class Kyle Massey on the USS Emory S. Land administered the first Moderna COVID-19 vaccine dose to Machinist Mate 3rd Class Brandy Mingus. This action underscores the military's ongoing commitment to vaccinating its personnel. Such proactive health measures are vital for maintaining troop readiness, ensuring force protection, and supporting sustained operational capabilities in a challenging global environment.

articles.title: MoD inks contract with Bengaluru-based firm for satellite jammers
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence signed a ₹200 crore contract with Bengaluru's Accord Software and Systems for 20 Enhanced Capability GNSS Receivers for the Indian Air Force. These indigenously designed systems will boost IAF's navigation capabilities and precise positioning, aligning with the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' initiative. Delivery is expected within 24 months, strengthening India's defence self-reliance.
